title: GenAI Layer: Narrate With Proof
objective: After this lesson you will be able to wrap computed analysis in templated natural-language answers with cited numbers, enforce abstention paths, and evaluate the layer on gold questions — ready for the final assessment and your capstone pack.
why: Stakeholders read sentences, not DataFrames: 'revenue grew 12% driven by shoes' beats a CSV dump — but only if every number traces to a computed cell. The GenAI layer translates analysis into narrative under grounding contracts (numbers from tables, citations attached, gaps abstained). Ungrounded narration invents trends; grounded narration ships insights with receipts.

blocks.text: Answers assemble from **templates with computed slots**: narrative skeleton fixed, numbers injected from analysis outputs, citations attached per figure. Slots never accept free prose where numbers belong (typed slots: currency, percent, count). Template + computed context is the entire architecture — the model (or formatter) fills slots, never invents them.

blocks.code:
TEMPLATE = "Revenue {total} ({pct:+.1f}% vs prior), driven by {top_cat} ({cat_total})."
computed = {"total": "$427.00", "pct": 12.3, "top_cat": "shoes", "cat_total": "$368.00"}
print(TEMPLATE.format(**computed))
# Slot contract: every {name} exists in computed; missing slot aborts, never blanks.

blocks.text: Every figure cites its source cell (table + row + computation); questions without computed answers abstain with the gap named ('no August data loaded — cannot compare'). Abstention paths are designed outputs (Prompt 101 discipline), not failures — and abstention rates track corpus coverage over time.

blocks.code:
def narrate(question, tables):
    if "revenue" in question and "sales" in tables:
        t = tables["sales"]["total"]
        return f"Revenue {t} [sales.total]."
    return "Unknown: no computed table covers this question [gap:tables]."

print(narrate("revenue?", {"sales": {"total": "$427.00"}}))
print(narrate("churn?", {"sales": {"total": "$427.00"}}))

blocks.text: Gold questions with expected numbers + citations: faithfulness (figures match cells), coverage (cited claims ratio), abstention precision (gaps truly absent). Same metric triple as RAG generation eval — because it IS generation eval, over computed tables instead of retrieved chunks.

blocks.title: Fill slots, cite cells
blocks.note: Run it: cited revenue, then two abstentions (missing topic, missing table). Slots filled from computed cells or explicit gaps — never invented figures, in any language.

items: Templates with typed computed slots; missing slots abort, never blank-fill
Per-figure citations to cells; abstention with named gaps; abstention rate tracks coverage
Gold questions assert numbers + citations + abstentions — generation eval over tables

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice narrator on all three cases and map outputs. (b) In Python (your env), run both lesson snippets and confirm template fill + abstention paths. (c) Write two gold questions for your capstone data (one answerable with expected citation, one correctly abstaining) with verdicts.
hints: Outputs: cited revenue / topic-gap abstention / table-gap abstention (three paths, all designed).
Python: template formats computed dict; narrate covers both branches (verify by running).
Gold design: answerable (number + cell citation expected) vs unanswerable (abstention + gap name expected).
exercise.why: Slot discipline (abort on missing), abstention design (named gaps), and gold pairing (answerable + abstaining) are the three narration judgments.
exercise.code: # Narration pattern: computed slots + cell citations + named abstentions.

quiz.q: Summary states revenue never computed anywhere. Handling?
options: Abstain with named gap — uncomputed figures must never appear, however plausible
quiz.explain: Grounding contracts bind figures to cells. Plausible invention is still invention — abstention preserves trust.

quiz.q: Template slot missing at render. Correct behavior?
options: Abort with named gap — blank slots publish half-sentences that read as facts
quiz.explain: Missing slots are data gaps wearing formatting: abort explicitly with the gap named, never render around silence.

quiz.q: Abstention rate triples after new questions arrive. Reading?
options: Coverage signal: new questions exceed computed tables — extend analysis, not prompts
quiz.explain: Abstention tracks coverage: spikes mean the question space outgrew the tables. Fix with computation, not wording.

summary: Computed slots with citations, gaps with names, gold with both paths. Narrative ships insights with receipts — course complete, assessment next.
